attempts.actualText: A room brought together. Right down to the details. Kitchen fitting, bathroom fitting and interior refurbishment, with the practical work that brings each room together. Kitchen fitting Cabinetry, tiling & finishing Kitchens Fitting, plumbing, carpentry and tiling for a kitchen refurbishment. Bathrooms Bathroom fitting, plumbing and tiling, from room preparation to the final finish. Interiors Plastering, decorating and carpentry as part of a wider home renovation.
